summary: A mayor calls a settlement a surrender while a councilor says the city got off well.
realLife: A council voted unanimously to settle a church's religious-freedom suit over parking an RV on its land, against the mayor's advice. The mayor, in a race for another term, said the case should have gone to trial and that the settlement would make enforcement harder. A councilor running for his job said losing in court could have cost far more. The church's lawyer called it a win. The city paid a small sum and the lawyers' fees.
sources: Yahoo News (Pueblo, Colorado), 'Pueblo City Council votes against mayor, approves settlement with church over RV code', September 27, 2023: https://www.yahoo.com/news/pueblo-city-council-votes-against-214756284.html
